description: Check an application's status using its application token (at_...). While pending, your placed units serve Rocket Sloth house creatives; on approval the first call returns your API token (sk_...) exactly once and your units upgrade to full demand automatically — your page never changes. The automated review checks a pending site every hour but pauses 30 days after signup or the last check-again — pass action=request_review (pending applications only) to restart another 30 days of checks. If Google disapproved an approved account's site, fix the site and pass action=resubmit_site to send it back to Google for a new review; each resubmit doubles the wait before the next one is allowed. A Bearer web session (the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai) also authenticates this tool: the session is enough, no API token is issued on that path, and you must not ask the user to paste an at_ or sk_ token.

action.description: Optional. Omit for a normal status poll. Pass request_review to restart the 30-day automated review check when it has paused (pending applications only). Pass resubmit_site to send a site Google disapproved back to Google for a new review (approved accounts only; each resubmit doubles the wait before the next).

token.description: Your application token (at_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: application_status
